blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Tuesday assured the public that motorists would not face double penalties amid the reimplementation of the no-contact apprehension policy (NCAP) in select cities in Metro Manila. MMDA chair Atty. Don Artes said there would be no duplication because MMDA and local government units (LGUs) do not have cameras installed at the same locations. READ: NCAP reimplentation starts Monday in 5 Metro Manila cities “To confirm the duplication, we have coordinated with the LGUs.
